pro_course_detail.description:
These sessions are for students who want a diligent one-on-one coach to help them increase their overall English fluency through casual conversation practice.

Learning a second language takes exercise - like learning a dance. In order to really get good at speaking English and not lose that ability (not forget "the moves"), it's important that you build muscle memory in your mouth by using the language frequently and consistently. Unfortunately, there are still many people around the globe who currently don't encounter enough opportunities in their day-to-day lives to practice English. 

Many non-native English speakers after reaching a certain level, never improve their communication skills, and in unfortunate cases, some even start to lose skills they had previously worked hard to gain. 

I enjoy helping students improve their own sentences by identifying and/or recalling sophisticated words and then getting them in the habit of incorporating those words into their speech.

Let's chat about topics of your choice unless you prefer Teacher Amelia to suggest some. During these conversations, Amelia will ask lots of questions so you will learn to use the English language spontaneously and practically rather than from a boring irrelevant textbook. We can discuss unfamiliar vocabulary words, and grammatical rules pertinent to your sentences.

If there's a specific topic you'd like to study, please let me know! I enjoy creating customized materials for my students, tailored to help them achieve their individual goals. Additionally, I've invested in an excellent online resource featuring hundreds of well-organized worksheets, including articles, videos, audio files, vocabulary exercises, and discussion questions. These resources can be utilized to keep our "free conversation" lessons centered around specific topics that interest and motivate you. I'm also eager to hear about your career and any personal life updates you'd like to share during our conversations.

This is because it is impossible to forget our mother language. With this idea in mind, it is better to think of it as adding another accent into your arsenal. This way, you will be able to utilize the accent according to the language.

Speaking: Oftentimes when having a conversation with someone we do not think about our pronunciation. The way a native speaker speaks is not the it is written.

pro_course_detail.title: Reach for English! A Fun, Interactive Course to Build Reading, Speaking, & Writing Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
*This course is geared toward children ages 4 - 12. *

What will I learn in this course?
Reach for English is a course designed in collaboration with National Geographic Learning. It is a fun, interactive course with 3 Main Emphases: Reading, Speaking, & Writing. The lessons are all based on picture book stories, focusing on the development of reading skills. We will build English skills by focusing on phonics, grammar, spelling, listening & speaking comprehension, and oral writing.

What happens during a lesson?
In an individual class, we will begin with a Warm-Up to help students get into “English Mode.” We will also discuss the goals for today’s lesson and introduce the lesson topic. We will follow up with review when applicable, introduce new vocabulary and grammar, and play practise games. Together, we will read a story and practise discussion skills by asking and answering questions about the story as we read. We will end our lesson by writing sentences about the story using our new vocabulary.

How long is this course?
Each Course is 30 lessons long and may be purchased by individual lesson or in 10-course increments. 

What level is this course?
This course is accessible to Levels PREK - G4A. 

How is my progress?
I provide written feedback after every fifth lesson. This personalised report will provide a constructive, encouraging review of your listening and speaking skills, classroom engagement, foundational skills, and reading & oral writing skills. 

Can I review lessons after class?
Yes! All lessons are recorded independently by me and will be forwarded to the client after each session. Recordings are to ensure continued quality. Student information remains private.

What materials do you provide for each lesson?
Prior to each lesson, I provide relevant student enrichment materials such as practise book pages and videos. I do not require a student to have reviewed or completed these materials prior to the lesson.

In each lesson, we will build English skills by focusing on reading strategies & skills, vocabulary, speaking, fluency, phonics & phonological awareness, and writing.

In an individual class, we will begin with a Warm-Up to help students get into “English Mode.” We will also discuss the goals for that lesson and introduce the lesson topic. We will follow up with review when applicable, learn phonics, and improve pronunciation. Together, we will read a story and discuss it, building comprehension, vocabulary, and accuracy. Afterwards, we will practise retelling the story, practise free talk using new vocabulary, and practise oral writing.
